description: This file defines the GZIPResponseWrapper class, which wraps HttpServletResponse to enable GZIP compression for responses in a web application. It manages output streams and writers, handles error reporting, and overrides relevant methods to support response compression.

classes.name: GZIPResponseWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper for HttpServletResponse that provides GZIP compression capabilities for responses. It manages output streams, writers, and error states, ensuring proper handling of the response data when compression is applied.

methods.name: GZIPResponseWrapper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the wrapper with the original HttpServletResponse.

methods.name: createOutputStream
methods.description: Creates and returns a new GZIPResponseStream wrapping the original response.

methods.name: finishResponse
methods.description: Closes the writer or stream if open, handling exceptions and logging errors.

methods.name: flushBuffer
methods.description: Flushes the underlying output stream if it exists.

methods.name: getOutputStream
methods.description: Returns the ServletOutputStream; creates it if it doesn't exist, throwing an exception if the writer has already been used.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a PrintWriter wrapping the output stream; creates it if necessary, with logic to handle committed responses and ensuring getOutputStream hasn't been called before.

methods.name: sendError
methods.description: Overrides sendError to log the error and store the error code.

methods.name: setContentLength
methods.description: Empty method overridden to prevent setting content length, as the response will be compressed.
